scope: Complete original noninterpolated PCM8 mono kernel 0x40109c: random signed accumulator contents, raw samples, fractional forward/reverse/zero steps, all batch lengths 1..65, volumes 0..32, nine master gains. Output bytes, final position and prefetched last sample match. Native transactional prefetch/capacity rejection and zero-count guard. Excludes loop traversal, stereo and interpolation.
